crossRefs.note: Then Saul approached Samuel in the gateway, and said, “Please tell me where the seer’s house is.”

people.name: Samuel
people.line: Prophet and last judge of Israel before the kings

people.name: Saul
people.line: First king of Israel, anointed by Samuel

translations.web: Then Saul approached Samuel in the gateway, and said, “Please tell me where the seer’s house is.”
translations.bsb: Saul approached Samuel in the gateway and asked, “Would you please tell me where the seer’s house is?”
translations.kjv: Then Saul drew near to Samuel in the gate, and said, Tell me, I pray thee, where the seer's house is.
translations.asv: Then Saul drew near to Samuel in the gate, and said, Tell me, I pray thee, where the seer's house is.
